subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should #11955 remain one canonical umbrella, or should maintainers split it into scoped product/security design issues for metrics, semantic recall defaults, normal-session handoff, and restart preload?
rationale: The remaining work is not a single defect; it defines new API, default, visibility, privacy, storage, and gateway lifecycle behavior across stable memory/session/gateway surfaces.

options.title: Split Into Scoped Design Items
options.body: Create narrower design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, semantic recall scope, and restart preload so each has privacy, default, and validation criteria before implementation.

options.title: Keep One Canonical Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point and require future PRs to state which slice they implement and how they avoid conflicting current surfaces.

options.title: Close After Replacement Issues Exist
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers confirm narrower related issues fully preserve the remaining requirements.

recommendation.title: Split Into Scoped Design Items
recommendation.body: Create narrower design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, semantic recall scope, and restart preload so each has privacy, default, and validation criteria before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from prior issue review plus feature history on session memory and usage observability.
